steps.title: Dishwasher detergent only?
steps.body: Only use detergents designed for dishwashers. No dish soap or oversudsing agents.

steps.body: Repair drain motor when impeller stuck; replace if error persists.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair drain motor when impeller stuck; replace if error persists.

steps.title: Drain pump resistance
steps.body: Disconnect power. Measure drain pump winding — manual spec 4~5 Ω.

steps.title: Drain pump verified
steps.body: Drain pump winding within spec.

steps.title: Replace drain pump
steps.body: Replace drain motor / pump assembly.

steps.title: Water supply tap open?
steps.body: Verify the water supply tap is fully open and inlet hose is not kinked.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify the water supply tap is fully open and inlet hose is not kinked.

steps.body: Open the water supply tap and retest fill.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open the water supply tap and retest fill.

steps.title: Inlet hose and pressure OK?
steps.body: Repair kinked hose if needed. Water pressure should be 20–120 psi (140–830 kPa).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair kinked hose if needed. Water pressure should be 20–120 psi (140–830 kPa).

steps.title: Repair inlet hose
steps.body: Repair or replace kinked inlet hose.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair or replace kinked inlet hose.

steps.title: Inlet valve screen clean?
steps.body: Unscrew inlet hose at valve side. Clean filter of inlet valve if clogged.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unscrew inlet hose at valve side. Clean filter of inlet valve if clogged.

steps.title: Clean inlet screen
steps.body: Clean inlet valve filter and retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Clean inlet valve filter and retest.

steps.body: Inlet valve coil within spec. Check hall sensor if IE persists.

steps.body: Physical leak sources checked. Replace main PCB if AE persists with no leak found.
